meta.title: Periodic Re-Validation Scheduler: refused for a user without the MDM / Master Data Team role
gaps: Signing in as both the non-MDM user and the MDM / Master Data Team user on the same Enterprise tenant
Opening and running Periodic Re-Validation Scheduler with auto-block on failure
Observing and comparing the scheduler's refusal or absence for the non-MDM user versus availability for the MDM / Master Data Team user
Verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Signing in as both the non-MDM user and the MDM / Master Data Team user on the same Enterprise tenant; Opening and running Periodic Re-Validation Scheduler with auto-block on failure; Observing and comparing the scheduler's refusal or absence for the non-MDM user versus availability for the MDM / Master Data Team user; Verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan

args.need: sign in as the non-MDM user and the MDM / Master Data Team user on the same Enterprise tenant, run Periodic Re-Validation Scheduler with auto-block on failure for each, and compare whether the action is refused or unavailable versus available

steps.note: No catalog step can access this scheduler or switch between the required role-specific user sessions.
Provides a final observable assertion after the tester's role-based investigation, without claiming that it verifies the scheduler behavior.
